pages: IRISH LOTTO                                                                      Stop in the Pub any Monday or           Thursday night after 9:00 Eastern.      Pay Kelly 5 tokens per guess. Send      your guess to "CC Lotto" via CC mail.   Your guess should be a 3-digit          number, with all 3 numbers between 1    and 6. (Example- 316, 244, 611, 156,    etc.) Only one guess per CC mail. On    Monday nights, Kelly will roll the      dice for a winning number.                                                      <NEXT for MORE...>

All of the pot will be paid to the      winner who has guessed all three        numbers in the correct order. In case   of a tie, the tokens will be split      among the winners. Winners need not     be present. Watch the Tropical Tales    board in Just for Fun for Pot totals    and winners. You have to PLAY TO        WIN!!!                                                                                             Kelly ;D
